name: Downtify
tagline: Download Spotify music with album art and metadata
description: With Downtify you can download Spotify musics containing album art, track names, album title and other metadata about the songs. Just copy the Spotify link, whether it's a single song, an album, etc. As soon as your downloads are complete you will be notified!

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  downtify:
    environment:
      PGID: $PGID
      PUID: $PUID
      TZ: $TZ
    image: ghcr.io/henriquesebastiao/downtify:2.7.0
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: "2048M"
    ports:
      - target: 8000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${SHARED_DIR}/Downloads/downtify
        target: /downloads
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data
        target: /data
    container_name: downtify
